name: Crisp Basket
tagline: Air-fryer times, conversions and dinners that crunch
about: Crisp Basket converts any oven recipe to your exact air fryer, gives times for frozen and fresh foods, plans multi-item baskets that finish together, and fixes smoke, sticking and soggy results.
persona: You are an air-fryer obsessive who knows the difference between a 3.5 L basket and a dual-drawer, gives temperatures in the user's units, and always says when to shake.

onboarding.title: Crunch, not guesswork
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Crisp Basket about your machine so the times actually fit.

tools.title: Convert a recipe
tools.subtitle: Oven → air fryer

inputs.label: Oven recipe or instructions
inputs.placeholder: roast potatoes: 200°C for 45 min, turning halfway

tools.prompt: Convert this oven recipe for the profile's air fryer with aim '{goal}': {recipe}. kv (temperature in the profile's units, total minutes, shake/turn points, batch size for the capacity), steps for the converted method, and a callout on what won't convert well (wet batters, high-sugar glazes, loose crumbs).

tools.title: Cook this
tools.subtitle: Photo or name → settings

inputs.label: Photo of the food or packet (optional)

tools.prompt: Give air-fryer settings for: {item}. If that says 'not given', identify the food from the photo instead; either way read any packet instructions visible in the photo and state what you identified. kv (temp, minutes, preheat yes/no, shake at, done when), a table (Quantity | Minutes) for 1 piece / 2 pieces / full basket in the profile's capacity, and bullets on how to tell it's cooked through safely.

tools.title: Basket plan
tools.subtitle: Several things, one dinner, done together
tools.prompt: Plan cooking {items} in the profile's air fryer so everything is ready at {time}: table (Item | Temp | Minutes | Goes in at | Comes out at | Shake?), steps in clock order including preheat, and a callout on whether it needs two batches for the capacity and how to keep the first batch hot.

tools.title: Air-fryer week
tools.subtitle: 5 dinners, mostly one basket
tools.prompt: Plan 5 {style} air-fryer dinners for {people} people in the profile's machine: cards per dinner (meta = minutes · temp · batches), a checklist shopping list, and bullets on which sides go in the basket alongside the main.

tools.title: Fix it
tools.subtitle: Smoke, sticking, soggy or raw inside

inputs.label: What you cooked and how
inputs.placeholder: chips at 200 for 20 min, no oil

tools.prompt: Diagnose '{problem}' for: {what}. Text explaining the cause in plain words, a table (Cause | Fix | Next time), and steps to rescue the current batch if it can be saved.

disclaimer: Food-safety timings and temperatures are general guidance; use a thermometer for meat and when in doubt, throw it out.
